definitions.explanation: A disaster of large scale that causes extensive damage or heavy loss of life.

examples.japanese: {大災害|だいさいがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧。
examples.english: Be struck by a major disaster.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大災害|だいさいがい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This earthquake became the worst catastrophe since the war.

examples.japanese: {大災害|だいさいがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、{各家庭|かくかてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧や⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備蓄|びちく}→備蓄：07589_bichiku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おくこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勧|すす}められている→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Each household is encouraged to stockpile food and water in preparation for a major disaster.

notes:
Composed of the prefix {大|だい} (large, major) + ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧ (disaster). Emphasizes the scale and severity of the damage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大災害|だいさいがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧: to be struck by a catastrophe
- {大災害|だいさいがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to prepare for a major disaster

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}{災害|さいがい}→自然災害：29290_shizensaigai⟧: natural disaster — classifies by cause rather than scale
- ⟦{惨事|さんじ}→惨事：28385_sanji⟧: tragic accident; disaster — stresses the tragic, horrific nature of the event
